description: Hi! I’m Paras, a B.Sc. Computer Science student interested in Data Science, AI/ML, NLP, and Web Development. For NASA Space Apps 2026, I’m exploring the “Flame in Freefall” challenge to build an AI-powered solution using NASA’s microgravity combustion data. Looking for teammates skilled in AI/ML, data analysis, visualization, software, UI/UX, space science, research, or presentation. 🚀
